query.description: NQE source text to validate. Give exactly one of query and query_id.

query_id.description: A SAVED library query to validate by id (Q_...) instead of text. Give exactly one of query and query_id. It runs by id; its source is read for the offline checks.

commit_id.description: With query_id: the library commit to run it at (default: the head).
